subject: general
question:
Simplify the following expression: 

 (sin theta)/(1+cos theta)+(1+cos theta)/(sin theta)
solution:
**Given:**

 (sin theta)/(1+cos theta)+(1+cos theta)/(sin theta)

**Formula used:**

1. sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

2. 1 + cos²θ = (1 + cos θ)²

**Calculations:**

 (sin theta)/(1+cos theta)+(1+cos theta)/(sin theta)

⇒ (sin² theta + (1+cos theta)²)/((1+cos theta)sin theta)

⇒ (sin² theta + 1 + cos² theta + 2cos theta)/((1+cos theta)sin theta)

⇒ (1 + 1 + 2cos theta)/((1+cos theta)sin theta) (Using sin²θ + cos²θ = 1)

⇒ (2 + 2cos theta)/((1+cos theta)sin theta)

⇒ (2(1 + cos theta))/((1+cos theta)sin theta)

⇒ (2)/(sin theta) = 2 times cosec theta

**∴ The simplified expression is 2 cosec θ.**
